Adaptation changes, 2026-10-12:
- Replaced score_keyword.py, analyze_pricing.py and query_dataset.py invocation
  instructions with typed native fiverr_market_analyze requests.
- Retained gather, candidate, deterministic score/price, offer-copy, draft and
  owner-review sequence from the existing skill rather than creating new skills.
- Added exact integer/rational money, explicit currency/scale/provenance,
  input bounds, missing-value distinctions and narrow canonical row schema.
- Preserved source scoring defaults, inclusive percentiles, ties-to-even major
  recommendations and actual first-observed tied-mode semantics. Source comments
  and sample examples that contradict these algorithms are not treated as goldens.
- Removed Python/Node/shell invocation, live scrape/profile import, external
  datasets/actors, FX, uploaded contributions/tokens, automerge/refresh, browser
  PDF/canvas rendering, AI-image execution and assets those branches depended on.
- Supplied observations/local imports replace data acquisition. The adaptation
  does not grant Fiverr collection permission or imply live account verification.
- Metrics are ordinary supplied-counter ratios, not upstream market predictions.

Pinned source paths and blob identifiers are recorded in skills.lock.json.
The adapted instruction and request contract are in skills/fiverr-gig-optimizer/
SKILL.md; semantic details and verification boundaries are in docs/skills.md.
No source scripts or market datasets are shipped or executed by this package.

Neither Ahad690, the contributors nor Fiverr endorses this adaptation.
The original MIT and CC-BY disclaimers remain applicable. Data rights and
Fiverr platform permission are separate from these software/document licenses.
